name: Cinder & Crowns
storyline: The mother-continent has fallen and the old empires lie in ruins. The player rises as a new lord, rebuilds a city-state from the ashes, recruits legendary heroes from across history, forges alliances, and competes for seasonal control of an ever-shrinking sandbox map in pursuit of a lost golden age.
summary: Cinder & Crowns is a mobile 4X strategy game (SLG) for iOS and Android. Players rebuild a fallen city-state from the ruins of a collapsed empire, command 30 legendary heroes drawn from real history, and compete for seasonal control of an ever-shrinking sandbox map. Armies of infantry, cavalry, and archers follow a counter triangle; heroes ascend, learn skills, and form bonds; and players join alliances to rally, raid bosses, and lay siege. The design emphasizes fairer competition, where coordination and timing matter more than spending.
